report.title: al-Idrisi — Docs Diátaxis Migration
report.subtitle: Collapsed three Markdown directories (design/, docs/, specs/) into a single docs/ tree organized by purpose. All cross-references rewritten, all links verified.

overview.summary: Collapsed design/, docs/, specs/ into a single docs/ tree organized by Diátaxis purpose (explanation/, how-to/, reference/, tutorials/). All relative cross-references rewritten to new paths and verified by a Python script. Result: 13 total .md files (12 in docs/ + 1 root README).

files.summary: Root README rewritten — 12 internal links from ./design/..., ./specs/... repointed to ./docs/explanation/, ./docs/reference/
New Diátaxis index — explanation/, how-to/, reference/, tutorials/
Renamed from design/ — architecture, build-roadmap, tech-stack, data-sources, inspirations
Renamed from specs/ — observability, data-schema-v0.1, README (stable contracts)

decisions.title: Adopt Diátaxis structure
decisions.detail: Organized docs by purpose — explanation/, how-to/, reference/, tutorials/ — instead of by document type (design/, specs/).
tradeoffs: + clearer mental model for new contributors
− requires every existing internal link to be rewritten
− README location changed → broken external links until redirects set

decisions.title: Python script to verify markdown links
decisions.detail: Added scripts/verify_links.py — walks the docs/ tree, parses each .md, checks that every relative link resolves to an existing file.
tradeoffs: − extra repo dependency (stdlib only, no pip install)
